description: Connect the user's Nepternship account to this assistant through Nepternship's sign-in page (Google, Apple or email, plus a verified mobile number for new members). Use this when an existing member wants to see their introductions or asks to sign in, or when a new member has saved their join answers and has no request waiting. Pass join_code from sign_up so the new account is created from the saved answers. Once connected it returns the account status.

join_code.description: The join_code from sign_up, when a new member saved their join answers in this conversation

name: connect_account
title: Connect Nepternship account
